risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (e.g., different Yamaha PSR-E series or another brand) leading to wrong pricing and wrong feature set.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label on the front panel (or the back/underside sticker with model and serial).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic 61-key portable keyboard (worst-case for value vs PSR-E453).

risks.risk: Not working or partially working keys/speakers/buttons (common risk with used keyboards).
risks.proof: Video showing power-on, screen/display working, playing several keys across the range, and sound through the built-in speaker (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume not working until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual) affecting usability and total cost.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (charger/power adapter, any pedals, cables, manual) and a close-up of the adapter label (voltage).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing accessories (buyer must source them).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or heavy wear not fully visible (scratches, broken knobs/buttons, damaged speaker grille).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: speaker grille, control knobs/buttons, display area, and the keybed/edges (including any cracks).
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower tier for visible wear/unknown condition.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the exact model text (front panel) or the back/underside sticker with model + serial number.
Power-on video: show the display, then play keys across low/middle/high range and demonstrate sound from built-in speaker.
Photo/video of included items: power adapter/charger, any pedal, and packaging/stand if present.
Close-up photos of the control panel (buttons/knobs), speaker grille, and any visible damage.
response.reason: The photo confirms a 61-key portable keyboard, but the Yamaha PSR-E453 model cannot be read clearly, and working condition/accessories are not verifiable from the single image. To price confidently, we need the exact model identification and a basic power-on/play test.
